title: I'd rather have the banana, please.
scene: 水果二选一，他坚持偏好。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Do you want an apple or a banana?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I'd rather have the banana, please.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: But you had a banana this morning, remember?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I know! I like bananas better than apples.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Why do you like them so much?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Bananas are soft and sweet. I'd rather eat them every day!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: If you eat bananas every day, you might turn into a monkey!
